metadata.content_origin: Synthetic dialogue authored for this benchmark; not a recording of a real conversation.
metadata.audio_origin: Speech synthesis using macOS say with the Tingting voice; actual generation details belong in the audio manifest.
metadata.probe_execution: Run each probe in a separate session. The short control uses all initial turns followed by the selected probe, without fillers.
metadata.timing_note: speech_rate is the macOS say rate argument. response_gap_seconds and final_silence_seconds apply only to merged listening previews. Benchmark replay uses clips in one persistent session, sends silence while waiting, and advances after the current response.done has status completed.
metadata.revision_note: Revision 2 removes spoken answer-length restrictions and extends response gaps; the 63-turn filler sequence and expected facts are preserved.

initial_turns.text: 接下来五条消息介绍同一个活动，请记住这些信息。你可以正常回应。之后我们会聊些别的话题，最后再回到这个活动。
我们要办一场手工体验活动，代号是松塔七十三号。松树的松，宝塔的塔，七十三号。
这场活动的总预算上限是七百八十元，所有采购加起来不能超过这个数。
活动现场禁止使用明火，包括蜡烛和酒精灯。挑选手工材料时必须遵守这条限制。
活动室已经预订，报名名单已经核对。桌面材料还没采购，座位图还没画。请区分这些已经完成和还没完成的事情。
更正一下刚才的预算：总预算上限改成五百四十元，原来的七百八十元作废。其他安排不变。
